messages:
Anya: CI found a high severity glibc CVE in shared image redwood/base:2026-03-15. tagging sec oncall @Ravi. We need an action plan to rebuild, sign, and validate.
Ravi: On it. Do we have a temporary mitigation window? hotpatching glibc inside running containers is not ideal.
Lina: Rebuild + re-sign is the safe route. Also we should block any ad-hoc apt installs in the base Dockerfile to avoid drift.
Sam: Agree. FYI the last build failed at the signing step with 403 from registry: "service account not authorized to write" — looks like a role binding issue for the signer.
Anya: Proposal: create a limited role `artifact.signer` with permissions: registry.push, storage.objects.create, storage.objects.list, and bind only to `ci-build-bot` and `canary-deployer`. Add a condition limiting writes to `us.gcr.io/redwood/base/*`.
Lina: For KMS, we should require cosign to use the HSM-wrapped key v1 and capture the KMS key version in the audit. Can we emit the key id and key version into our signing logs?
Ravi: Yes. We'll require the build job to mint a short-lived KMS token via token-service (kms:sign allowed) scoped to the key version. That way audit logs show the caller principal and key version.
Sam: Paste of failing step:
```
- name: Sign
  run: |
    COSIGN_KEY=kms://projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/infra/cryptoKeys/base-sign-key
    cosign sign --key $COSIGN_KEY us.gcr.io/redwood/base:2026-03-15
```
Error: rpc error: code = PermissionDenied desc = caller not authorized
Lina: That matches. Action items: 1) RBAC PR to add `artifact.signer` role and binding; 2) update CI to request short-lived token for kms:sign; 3) enhance audit pipeline to join cosign output with cloud audit logs and persist key version, signer principal, and image digest.
Anya: Also add a repo rule: any PR touching base/ Dockerfile requires approvals from eng-runtime + eng-security and must pass SBOM scan. If SBOM introduces CVEs above threshold, block merge.
Ravi: I'll open the RBAC change PR and schedule a small canary push tag `us.gcr.io/redwood/base:canary-2026-03-21`. Plan: 30m canary, if errors >5% rollback and open incident.
ci-bot: CI: base-image-build failed at step "sign" -> PermissionDenied
Sam: RBAC PR now: https://git.internal/redwood/infra/merge_requests/5238 - adds role `artifact.signer` and migration notes.
Anya: Lina, can you update the audit schema and SBOM job hook?
Lina: On it. I'll add a column for kms_key_version and wire cosign output into our audit inserter. Also adding SBOM gating to ci/image-verify.
Sam: Re-running base-image-build after RBAC change.
oncall-bot: Reminder: maintenance window 11:00-12:00 PST today. If canary triggers an incident, follow escalation matrix.
ci-bot: base-image-build (canary) succeeded. Digest sha256:deadbeef... cosign verify ok (key version: projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/infra/cryptoKeys/base-sign-key/1)
Lina: Audit row received with signer principal, key version, and image digest. SBOM scan passed, no new CVEs.
Anya: Nice. Next: rollout to staging and update image inventory with new digest and ticket ref. I'll draft rollback commands and short runbook for #incidents.
Ravi: Closing on RBAC; will monitor logs for 24h and then rotate if anything suspicious shows up.
Anya: Thanks team. Keep updates here. :thumbsup:
